data.title: Myanmar airstrike toll hits 50 as families gather dead
data.description: KYAUKTAW, Myanmar - Families searched for bodies on Tuesday around a charred market in western Myanmar after a military airstrike killed 50 people, one of the deadliest recent bombardments in the civil war.

data.title: UN concerned by Malaysia returns of Myanmar migrants
data.description: GENEVA — The United Nations (UN) voiced worry Tuesday as Malaysia started sending thousands of Myanmar nationals back to the war-torn country, warning that conditions there would not enable "safe, dignified and sustainable returns".

data.title: AI bosses head to White House as safety pressure builds
data.description: WASHINGTON - Leading artificial intelligence executives were preparing to meet at the White House on Tuesday with President Donald Trump and a top Republican as the US Congress calls for stronger industry oversight.

data.title: Unstoppable An retains Asian Games badminton crown
data.description: NAGOYA, Japan - Badminton world number one An Se-young said it was “like a dream” as she retained her Asian Games crown on Tuesday in style, as more rain washed out the cricket and organisers apologised for the latest transport fiasco.

data.title: Fifa and Uefa feuding over World Cup documents
data.description: PARIS - Tje International Federation of Association Football (Fifa) has accused the Union of European Football Associations (Uefa) of a “misinformation campaign” in its bid to access documents related to Gianni Infantino’s plan to sell off parts of the World Cup.

data.title: Nine drug smugglers killed in Chiang Rai shootout
data.description: Nine suspected drug smugglers were killed in an exchange of gunfire with security forces in a forested area in Mae Fa Luang district of Chiang Rai province on Monday night, with 272 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine seized.

data.title: Ratchaburi prepares to evacuate as Mae Klong River rises
data.description: Ratchaburi municipality on Tuesday alerted residents to be on standby for evacuation and ordered schools and childcare centres to close in the face of an imminent threat of major flooding from the rising Mae Klong River.

data.title: Indonesia charges train driver over crash that killed 16 women
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian police charged a train driver Tuesday with failing to brake in time to prevent a crash that killed 16 women near Jakarta in April, an official said.

data.title: Can Emotional Trauma Actually Heal?
data.description: Emotional trauma doesn't only come from major accidents or disasters. It can come from violence at home, being abandoned, a relationship that hurt you, or stress that built up for years with nobody around who understood.

data.title: Cabinet approves B160bn flood mitigation project
data.description: Thailand’s Cabinet on Tuesday approved a 160-billion-baht project to divert water from Chai Nat through the Pasak River towards the Gulf of Thailand as a long-term solution to recurring flood problems in Bangkok and the central region.

data.title: Heavy rain closes 2 waterfalls in Chiang Mai
data.description: CHIANG MAI - Doi Suthep-Pui National Park closed access to two rain-swollen waterfalls on Tuesday as provincial authorities instructed local officials to remain vigilant for sudden natural hazards arising from heavy accumulated rainfall.

data.title: AI-based weather forecasting ‘still being studied’
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (DES) has denied reports about cabinet approval of a 497-million-baht project to introduce AI-powered weather forecasting from US-based Tomorrow.io to the Thai Meteorological Department.

data.title: Bangkok flood will drain off 'in a few days'
data.description: The flooding in eastern Bangkok will drain off in a few more days, provided it does not rain again, government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises said on Tuesday.

data.title: 5,600 delayed bags, 330 stalled flights prompt THAI apology
data.description: The torrential rain and flooding in Bangkok over the weekend led to long delays in handling about 5,600 bags and 330 stalled Thai Airways International flights, after hundreds of airline workers were stranded at home, unable to go to work at the capital's two international airports.

data.title: 8 common health risks that follow flooding
data.description: With severe flooding affecting several parts of Thailand, health authorities are warning the public to be aware of diseases and other health risks associated with floodwater, contaminated surroundings and disrupted living conditions.

data.description: Flooding in Bangkok has begun to ease in some areas, but several locations remain inundated, particularly Khlong Sam Wa district and the Khlong Chan flats in Bang Kapi district, where floodwater in some areas remains more than one metre deep.

data.title: North Korean DMZ landmine blast 'violation of armistice'
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's defence chief said Tuesday that the preliminary findings of an investigation into last week's landmine explosion inside the Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) found North Korea responsible, saying the blast violated the armistice agreement.

data.title: U2 mark 50 years together with concert at school where it all began
data.description: DUBLIN - ⁠U2 marked ⁠50 years as ​a band on Friday by returning to the school where they started playing together as ​teenagers and delighted current students with ‌a concert featuring hits such as With Or Without You , One and Beautiful Day .

data.title: Myanmar airstrike death toll rises to 50
data.description: NAY PYI TAW — The death toll from a military airstrike in west Myanmar rose to 50 on Tuesday, two local aid workers at the scene said, the day after it struck a busy market.

data.title: Frenchman shoots himself at Phuket gun range
data.description: PHUKET - A French visitor shot himself in the head at a shooting range on Monday and was rushed to hospital, where he remained in a serious condition on Tuesday.

data.title: Heavy rain floods Kanchanaburi, leaves two missing and 400 households evacuated
data.description: KANCHANABURI — Heavy rain has triggered widespread flooding across this western province, forcing more than 400 households to evacuate, disrupting power and communications and leaving a mother and daughter missing after their pickup truck was swept away by floodwaters.

data.title: Thai Airways cancels 8 more flights amid luggage chaos
data.description: Thai Airways International has cancelled eight more flights on routes between Bangkok and Khon Kaen, Phuket, Hanoi and Singapore amid the baggage handling chaos at Suvarnabhumi airport.

data.title: Mae Klong Dam boosts discharge as flood-hit provinces remain inundated
data.description: KANCHANABURI — Communities living downstream of the Mae Klong Dam face imminent flooding as the dam increases water discharges to prevent it from reaching capacity.

data.title: Malaysia begins sending home Myanmar refugees despite safety concerns
data.description: LUMUT, Malaysia - Malaysia began the process of deporting around 1,500 Myanmar nationals on Tuesday as part of a refugee repatriation programme, defying objections from the United Nations and dozens of human rights groups.

data.title: Vietnam arrests three on terrorism charges, including Norwegian and Australian citizens
data.description: HO CHI MINH — Vietnam police have ⁠arrested ⁠three people, including a Norwegian ​citizen and an Australian national of Vietnamese origin, accusing them of terrorism, in ​an operation that a pro-democracy group says ‌was conducted in Cambodia.

data.title: Irish Film Festival returns for 8th edition
data.description: The Embassy of Ireland in Thailand is hosting the Irish Film Festival, with 2026 marking the 8th edition of the festival in Thailand.
